text:
there is a current log that reads like: [js.warn] [route] /editor first render +375ms
[js.warn] [route] /editor loaded +375ms however, this is only telling half the story. I need you to extend this log and capture a REAL total load time on routes, being how long until i as a user can actually do something. We will keep instrumenting the log until it gets a real time. Currently the editor route takes me more like anywhere from 2-4 seconds on average
resolution: Extended hmsc-int route timing so route loaded no longer returns immediately when requestAnimationFrame is absent, waits for timer-frame calm plus native host-flush drain calm, and reports JS/native flush deltas. Added a lightweight runtime dispatch hook so the route log also prints the first actionable post-navigation input event, giving a direct user-can-interact reality check against the loaded number. Verified by bundling hmsc-int with scripts/cart-bundle.js via tools/v8cli.
